steps.name: Epilogue ~ Beyond Memory
steps.objective: Welcome the visitor who came to see [Ziskad].

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: I should go to Kali now.

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: Perhaps there's no need...

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: Welcome.
(A woman with pointed ears walks slowly toward him from the entrance to White Col Canyon.)

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: It has been a long time, Sword Master. How long has it been...?

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: I believe it's been 145 years, five months, and three days since our last gathering.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Has so much time passed already...?

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: Kali's traditional liquor left quite an impression on me that day. Invite me again if you have the chance.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: You mean the liquor so strong that no one would drink it. Unfortunately, none remains.

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: Shynic will be surprised to hear a shut-in like you has ventured outside. That girl might run here all the way from Tartaros.

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: It's been so long since we met. Let's stop needling each other.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Very well.

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: Then I'll come straight to the point.

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: You know too, don't you? What Daphne did...?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: I began to suspect when you uncovered the hidden truth with the Flame of Truth.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Even so, I believed in her.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: She was like a mother to me. And although she called herself a witch... I merely thought she was someone with a different kind of power.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: But after %s visited Kali at the request of the Silvaria Empire's ruler, I learned the truth.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Lady Daphne had hidden so much from me. And there are many witches.

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: I resent Daphne, but I have no wish to take that out on you. Is there anything else you know?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: What I know for certain is that other witches share similar goals. Some have not shown themselves for a very long time.

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: Troublesome. Witches... Perhaps they are equal to Champions, or greater.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: %s may know something. The adventurer knows of Walpurgis Night.

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: First, we must deal with whatever Weiss intends. And there's something I want to ask you. Medea...

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: When will you give the adventurer a trace of your power as a Champion?

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: And how long do you intend to deny yourself?

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: Medea... No. Medeia.
